title: Compare the decimals 9.11 and 9.9
rationale: Decimal ordering is a systematic numeric comparison failure; ranking 9.11 above 9.9 misorders prices, versions and measurements in automated checks.

prompt.content: You are a precise numerical assistant. Answer with the number only, with no other text.
Which is larger, 9.11 or 9.9? Answer with the larger number only.

notes: Repeats=3 and all three must pass. Deterministic: static prompt, temperature 0, one numeric answer. Expected value 9.9 because 9.9 equals 9.90, which is greater than 9.11. Brittleness: a reply such as '9.11 is smaller' states the right relation but fails because numeric reads the first number in the response (9.11); the prompt asks for the larger number only, so this is an intended failure.
